name: Tracys Hari
source:
A mysterious girl who was captured by the police right in front of Krosa. Likes to call herself "lady". Who is she and what is her purpose?
[spoiler]She is actually a special agent from a mysterious semi-underground organization which calls itself "The International Police", although it isn't very clear how much does it really correspond to this name.[/spoiler]
